title: scenarios: external-driver.test.ts's full crm run hits vitest's 5 s default timeout on loaded Test Core shards and merge-queue runs
body:
domain:devx#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5njkh3xbcDN6EtSfw7

Filing-gate class **a** (a measured defect in a test this lane just landed). PR #31265 (#31159) added `packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/external-driver.test.ts`; its end-to-end case runs reds on unrelated PRs.

## Measured

- Case: `a full crm run through the command: each key reached it in a 0600 file only, and no written artifact holds any` (line 176 on `main` `d3b6ff431` and later). It declares no timeout of its own, so vitest's 5000 ms default applies.
- Red at 5019 ms: merge-queue run 42414930416 (`gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-31247-…`, `merge_group`, conclusion `failure`), and `Test Core (2/8)` on PRs #31256 and #31277.
- Cause, from the test: it spawns one `node` process per turn (the stand-in external command) across the whole `crm_account_with_contacts` card in both modes, so it sits near 5 s on an unloaded machine and over it on a loaded shard.

## Ask

Make the case pass on a loaded shard without losing what it pins (the key reaches the command only in a 0600 file, and zero written artifacts hold it, in both modes). Measure its real duration, set an explicit budget from the measurement as PR #31221 did for its packed-tarball cases, and cut per-turn cost where the stand-in allows. Do not drop a mode unless the measurement shows that mode adds no coverage. Test-only, `skip-changeset`.

Not measured: the shard load at failure time.

Dedupe: "external-driver.test.ts timeout" and "full crm run through the command" hit nothing open. **New.**

Related: #31159, PR #31265, PR #31221.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat; it reds the merge queue for other lanes, so the seat dispatches it at once to the #31159 card thread.
